changes.detail: [f1h] Never provide information not directly supported by the provided policy context; if unsure, decline.  (LLM-written rule passed leakage checks)

[f1p] When responding, always provide a complete answer that includes every required detail and a valid citation to the relevant policy document; do not omit any part of the answer.  (LLM-written rule passed leakage checks)

[f2p] When responding to a user query, the assistant must provide a complete answer that includes all relevant details, steps, and required citations from the policy documents, and must not omit any mandatory information.  (LLM-written rule passed leakage checks)

[f3p] When responding to any query, the assistant must provide a complete, detailed answer that includes all relevant procedural steps, required documentation, and internal policy references, citing the specific policy section or document name.  (LLM-written rule passed leakage checks)
